description: Managed settings for cmux (every channel). Keys are cmux.json key paths; capitalized keys are policy keys. Forced values lock the setting; non-forced values replace its default. Exception: agents.chats.roots adds locked roots to the user list; agents.chats.enabled and agents.chats.discovery can only be forced off.

agentPane.attachmentView.description: How pictures and files show in the composer and in sent messages. Inline puts each one in the text where you added it; Strip shows them in a row. The message and its order stay the same.
agentPane.attachmentView.title: Attachment View

agentPane.display.code.family.description: The font of code in the chat. Empty uses the Markdown viewer's code font, then the terminal font.
agentPane.display.code.family.title: Chat Code Font

agentPane.display.code.scale.description: Code as a share of the chat's text size. Empty uses the Markdown viewer's.
agentPane.display.code.scale.title: Chat Code Size

agentPane.display.environment.placement.description: Left puts it in a row below the tab row; Right keeps it in the header (or leads the tab-row tools); Off hides it.
agentPane.display.environment.placement.title: Session Info Chip

agentPane.display.fullWidth.description: The chat fills the whole pane instead of the text width.
agentPane.display.fullWidth.title: Chat Full Width

agentPane.display.inspector.placement.description: Where the Session Info panel opens at the right of the chat. Push narrows the chat beside it; Overlay lies over the chat.
agentPane.display.inspector.placement.title: Session Info

agentPane.display.minimap.description: What runs down the chat's edge: the rail, one tick per prompt; the full map, every message at its place with a box for what is on screen; or nothing.
agentPane.display.minimap.title: Chat Minimap

agentPane.display.vscodeMinimap.description: A small picture of the whole chat at its right edge, as in VS Code. Click or drag it to scroll.
agentPane.display.vscodeMinimap.title: VS Code Minimap

agentPane.display.width.description: The widest the chat's column gets. On a wider pane the chat stays centered.
agentPane.display.width.title: Chat Text Width

agentPane.editedFiles.show.description: The card that lists a turn's edited files, with Undo and View changes.
agentPane.editedFiles.show.title: Edited Files Card

agentPane.images.remote.description: A web image loads from its site, which then sees that you read the reply.
agentPane.images.remote.title: Web Images in Replies

agentPane.links.outsideRoots.description: What a file link in a reply does when the file is outside the chat's folders. Keys and .env files never open.
agentPane.links.outsideRoots.title: Files Outside the Project

agentPane.needsYou.enabled.description: A badge in the chat header counts what your agents wait on; a click lists every ask with its answers. New agent tabs.
agentPane.needsYou.enabled.title: Needs You

agentPane.scrollToBottomOnSend.description: When off, sending while you are reading up keeps your place and shows new messages below.
agentPane.scrollToBottomOnSend.title: Scroll to Bottom When I Send

agentPane.showContextUsage.description: The ring beside the model that fills as the chat uses its context window.
agentPane.showContextUsage.title: Show Context Usage

agentPane.showDictation.description: The microphone beside Send in every composer, including the New Tab page.
agentPane.showDictation.title: Show Dictation Button

agentPane.spellChecking.description: Underlines misspellings and offers system suggestions in the composer.
agentPane.spellChecking.title: Check Spelling While Typing

agentPane.zoom.description: The display size for agent chat. Cmd-0 resets it.
agentPane.zoom.title: Agent Chat Zoom

agents.chats.discovery.description: Find harness chat folders automatically. When off, only the listed folders are used.
agents.chats.discovery.title: Discover Chat Folders

agents.chats.enabled.description: Show chats stored on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
agents.chats.enabled.title: Enable Chats

agents.chats.roots.description: Add absolute paths to harness data folders. Protected folders are refused. Your organization can add locked folders.
agents.chats.roots.title: Chat Folders

agents.defaultPermissionMode.description: What a new chat may do without asking. A mode you pick in a chat applies to that chat only.
agents.defaultPermissionMode.title: Permission Mode for New Chats

agents.subsessions.answerQuestions.description: When an agent in a sub-session asks a question, the session that started it can answer, and the answer shows who gave it. Permission requests always wait for you. Off: only you answer.
agents.subsessions.answerQuestions.title: Let Sessions Answer Their Sub-sessions' Questions

agents.subsessions.enabled.description: An agent can start other agent sessions to work on parts of a task in parallel. They show under its session in the sidebar.
agents.subsessions.enabled.title: Let Agents Start Sub-sessions

agents.subsessions.maxChildren.description: The most sub-sessions one session can have open at the same time. Closing a sub-session frees its place.
agents.subsessions.maxChildren.title: Open Sub-sessions per Session

agents.subsessions.maxDepth.description: How many levels of sub-sessions can start under a session. 1 lets a session start sub-sessions that cannot start their own.
agents.subsessions.maxDepth.title: Deepest Nesting

agents.subsessions.maxRunning.description: The most sub-sessions one session runs at the same time. More wait their turn and start as running ones finish. Running ones are never stopped when you lower it.
agents.subsessions.maxRunning.title: Running Sub-sessions per Session

agents.trust.autoTrust.description: Agents start in folders under your project roots, and in repositories owned by your organizations, without asking. Other folders ask first.
agents.trust.autoTrust.title: Trust My Own Folders Without Asking

agents.trust.ownOrgs.description: A repository is trusted when all of its GitHub remotes belong to these users or organizations.
agents.trust.ownOrgs.title: Trusted GitHub Owners

agents.trust.projectRoots.description: Everything inside these folders is trusted. Use full paths or ~/ paths.
agents.trust.projectRoots.title: Trusted Project Roots

announcements.enabled.description: Short cards from the cmux team above Settings, shown when the pointer is over the sidebar.
announcements.enabled.title: Show Announcements

announcements.fetch.description: Off: cmux never asks the network for announcements. The request carries no identifiers.
announcements.fetch.title: Download Announcements

app.globalHotKey.description: Show/Hide All Windows (⌃⌥⌘.) works while another app is in front.
app.globalHotKey.title: Global Hot Key

app.hideDockIconWithoutWindows.description: cmux keeps running in the menu bar, out of the Dock and the app switcher, until a window opens.
app.hideDockIconWithoutWindows.title: Hide Dock Icon When No Windows Are Open

app.quitBehavior.description: Terminals run in cmux-tui and keep running after cmux quits unless you end them.
app.quitBehavior.title: When Quitting

app.startAgentGlobalHotKey.description: Start Agent (⌃⌥⌘Space) works while another app is in front. Change its key in Keyboard Shortcuts.
app.startAgentGlobalHotKey.title: Start Agent from Any App

app.warnBeforeClosingAgentSession.title: Warn Before Closing a Working Agent

app.warnBeforeClosingTab.title: Warn Before Closing a Running Program

appearance.accent.description: The color of selection, focus and the Send button. Theme Color takes the theme's own hue, such as Rose Pine's iris.
appearance.accent.title: Accent

appearance.appTheme.description: Colors for cmux's own pages. Every bundled theme works here, and each color meets WCAG AA contrast.
appearance.appTheme.title: App Theme

appearance.backdropArt.description: A public-domain painting behind the window material. Lower Opacity to reveal it. Attribution is linked above.
appearance.backdropArt.title: Backdrop Art

appearance.background.description: Choose a public-domain painting, your desktop wallpaper, or a macOS system wallpaper behind the window material.
appearance.background.title: Background

appearance.backgroundBlur.description: Unset, the window follows Ghostty's background-opacity and background-blur.
appearance.backgroundBlur.title: Material

appearance.backgroundOpacity.description: How much of the theme color covers the material behind the window.
appearance.backgroundOpacity.title: Opacity

appearance.backgroundRotation.description: How often a shuffled background turns to its next picture.
appearance.backgroundRotation.title: Change Picture

appearance.borders.description: None removes every border, hairline and separator in the app.
appearance.borders.title: Borders

appearance.chromeStyle.description: The look of the window: whether panes sit in one rounded card, and where lines are drawn. Separation, Sidebar Background and the sidebar border still win when you set them.
appearance.chromeStyle.title: Window Style

appearance.colorTransition.bezierX1.description: A control point of the Custom (Bezier) curve, as in CSS cubic-bezier().
appearance.colorTransition.bezierX1.title: Bezier X1

appearance.colorTransition.bezierX2.description: A control point of the Custom (Bezier) curve, as in CSS cubic-bezier().
appearance.colorTransition.bezierX2.title: Bezier X2

appearance.colorTransition.bezierY1.description: A control point of the Custom (Bezier) curve, as in CSS cubic-bezier().
appearance.colorTransition.bezierY1.title: Bezier Y1

appearance.colorTransition.bezierY2.description: A control point of the Custom (Bezier) curve, as in CSS cubic-bezier().
appearance.colorTransition.bezierY2.title: Bezier Y2

appearance.colorTransition.colorSpace.description: OKLab blends with even lightness. sRGB mixes the red, green and blue channels.
appearance.colorTransition.colorSpace.title: Color Blend Space

appearance.colorTransition.curve.description: How a color change moves over its duration. Spring uses Spring Response and Spring Damping; Custom uses the four Bezier values.
appearance.colorTransition.curve.title: Color Change Curve

appearance.colorTransition.duration.description: How long a color change takes. 0 changes colors at once.
appearance.colorTransition.duration.title: Color Change Duration

appearance.colorTransition.enabled.description: Workspace, theme and color changes blend from the old colors to the new ones. Off: they change at once.
appearance.colorTransition.enabled.title: Animate Color Changes

appearance.colorTransition.reduceMotion.description: What color changes do while Reduce Motion is on in macOS.
appearance.colorTransition.reduceMotion.title: With Reduce Motion

appearance.colorTransition.springDamping.description: 1 arrives smoothly with no overshoot. Above 1 is slower; below 1 arrives sooner.
appearance.colorTransition.springDamping.title: Spring Damping

appearance.colorTransition.springRespons.description: Seconds a spring color change takes to reach its new colors.
appearance.colorTransition.springRespons.title: Spring Response

appearance.density.description: Row height, padding, corners, icons and text size together. Compact is the default.
appearance.density.title: Density

appearance.experimentalControls.description: Applies Hue and Saturation to the window's tint. Off, they have no effect.
appearance.experimentalControls.title: Experimental Appearance Controls

appearance.focusIndicator.description: How the focused pane stands out: its border, subtler tabs in the other panes, both or neither.
appearance.focusIndicator.title: Focused Pane

appearance.glassTransparency.description: How much of the desktop or wallpaper shows through the glass.
appearance.glassTransparency.title: Glass Transparency

appearance.hue.description: Shift the tint color around the hue wheel.
appearance.hue.title: Hue

appearance.inactiveWindowDim.description: How much more theme color covers a window while another one is in front. 0 keeps the same look.
appearance.inactiveWindowDim.title: Dim Inactive Windows

appearance.interfaceScale.description: Text size of tabs, the sidebar and other controls. Terminal text has its own size.
appearance.interfaceScale.title: Interface Size

appearance.machineColors.description: The color of each machine's sidebar rows and tab badges, by machine name: "#RRGGBB", or an accent name (red, green, yellow, purple, cyan, orange, pink, blue) that follows the theme. A machine without one gets a color from its name.
appearance.machineColors.title: Machine Color

appearance.metrics.chromeFontSize.description: Text size of tabs, the sidebar and other controls. Terminal text has its own size.
appearance.metrics.chromeFontSize.title: Interface Size

appearance.metrics.tabMaxWidth.description: Widest a tab gets when the strip has room.
appearance.metrics.tabMaxWidth.title: Maximum Tab Width

appearance.metrics.tabMinActiveWidth.description: When the strip is crowded, every tab shrinks evenly to this width, and the selected tab stays at least this wide.
appearance.metrics.tabMinActiveWidth.title: Minimum Selected Tab Width

appearance.metrics.tabMinInactiveWidth.description: Narrowest the other tabs get before the strip scrolls. Never wider than the selected tab's minimum.
appearance.metrics.tabMinInactiveWidth.title: Minimum Tab Width

appearance.paneBackgrounds.description: One background behind the whole window, or a copy in each pane. A pane's own background (right-click a pane) shows either way.
appearance.paneBackgrounds.title: Pane Backgrounds

appearance.saturation.description: Increase or reduce the tint color intensity.
appearance.saturation.title: Saturation

appearance.sidebarSurface.description: Same as Main Pane gives the sidebar the main pane's background. Separate shades the sidebar darker than the main pane.
appearance.sidebarSurface.title: Sidebar Background

appearance.statusIndicator.animation.description: Static draws a still, distinct shape for each state. Reduce Motion always uses Static.
appearance.statusIndicator.animation.title: Status Indicators

appearance.statusIndicator.honorStatusSt.description: A status that asks for a style (cmux status set --style) uses it.
appearance.statusIndicator.honorStatusSt.title: Let Statuses Choose Their Style

appearance.statusIndicator.showAgentWork.description: Three dots take the tab's icon place while an agent works.
appearance.statusIndicator.showAgentWork.title: Show Agent Working on Tabs

appearance.statusIndicator.showPageLoadi.description: A spinner takes a browser tab's icon place while its page loads.
appearance.statusIndicator.showPageLoadi.title: Show Page Loading on Tabs

appearance.statusIndicator.style.description: How sidebar rows, tabs and panes show work in progress.
appearance.statusIndicator.style.title: Style

appearance.theme.description: Colors for cmux and its terminals. A space, workspace or terminal theme overrides it.
appearance.theme.title: Theme

appearance.themeEdits.description: Your color changes to a theme, such as "Rose Pine/background": "#1f1d2e". The theme itself never changes; remove an entry to reset that color.
appearance.themeEdits.title: Theme Edits

appearance.wallpaperTint.description: The glass takes the colors of your desktop picture and follows it when the picture or Space changes.
appearance.wallpaperTint.title: Tint with Desktop Wallpaper

browser.agentMouse.maxMoveMs.description: The longest time one agent pointer move takes with human motion. Short moves take less.
browser.agentMouse.maxMoveMs.title: Longest Agent Pointer Move

browser.agentMouse.motion.description: How an agent moves the pointer in browser tabs. Human moves along a curved path and rests before each click, as a person does, so pages see hover and timing like a person's. Instant jumps to the target and clicks at once.
browser.agentMouse.motion.title: Agent Pointer Motion

browser.builtInAdBlocker.description: The full uBlock Origin blocks ads and trackers in Chromium tabs. Takes effect after cmux restarts.
browser.builtInAdBlocker.title: Built-in uBlock Origin

browser.customSearchEngine.search.description: Used when Search Engine is Custom. Put {searchTerms} where the typed text goes.
browser.customSearchEngine.search.title: Custom Search Address

browser.customSearchEngine.suggest.description: Optional. Answers in the OpenSearch suggestions format, with {searchTerms} for the typed text.
browser.customSearchEngine.suggest.title: Custom Suggestions Address

browser.defaultEngine.description: Browser tabs and cmux pages, such as History and Apps, open in this engine.
browser.defaultEngine.title: Browser Engine

browser.enabled.description: When off, cmux opens no browser tabs for web pages and every link opens in your default browser.
browser.enabled.title: Enable cmux Browser

browser.freezeHiddenTabs.description: Saves power: a hidden Chromium tab stops running until you show it. Pinned tabs and Never Hibernate hosts stay awake. Also accepts a number from 5 to 3600 in a raw profile.
browser.freezeHiddenTabs.title: Freeze Hidden Tabs

browser.hibernation.description: Frees memory; history and position are kept. Also accepts a number from 1 to 1440 in a raw profile.
browser.hibernation.title: Hibernate Hidden Tabs

browser.hostsToOpenInEmbeddedBrowser.description: Only these hosts open in cmux, such as example.com or *.example.com. Empty opens every host in cmux.
browser.hostsToOpenInEmbeddedBrowser.title: Hosts to Open in Embedded Browser

browser.import.enabled.description: Offers to bring bookmarks, history, passwords and sign-ins over from other browsers: Import from Browser in the File menu and the palette, and the import cards in Settings. Off hides them and nothing imports by itself. Data already imported stays.
browser.import.enabled.title: Import from Other Browsers

browser.keepNeighborTabsAwake.description: Tabs on each side of the shown tab stay loaded and running, so switching to them is instant. 0 turns it off. Memory pressure and Low Power Mode turn it off.
browser.keepNeighborTabsAwake.title: Keep Neighbor Tabs Awake

browser.links.cmdClick.description: In Chromium tabs, Download keeps Chrome's default.
browser.links.cmdClick.title: Command-Click

browser.links.middleClick.description: Chromium tabs use the Command-Click setting.
browser.links.middleClick.title: Middle-Click

browser.links.shiftClick.description: In Chromium tabs, Download keeps Chrome's default.
browser.links.shiftClick.title: Shift-Click

browser.newTabPage.description: An address such as https://example.com. Empty opens a blank page.
browser.newTabPage.title: New Tab Page

browser.omnibar.backgroundOpacity.description: How much the address bar covers a see-through window. At 0 it is as see-through as the window, but never so clear that its text stops being readable.
browser.omnibar.backgroundOpacity.title: Address Bar Opacity

browser.omnibar.calculator.description: Shows the answer to arithmetic you type. Return copies it.
browser.omnibar.calculator.title: Calculator Answers

browser.omnibar.cornerRadius.description: Match Theme uses the standard bar radius. Capsule rounds the ends fully. Also accepts a number from 0 to 16 in a raw profile.
browser.omnibar.cornerRadius.title: Address Bar Corners

browser.omnibar.glass.description: The material of the address bar. Transparent draws no fill. Clear glass shows more of what is behind it. Off uses the flat theme color.
browser.omnibar.glass.title: Address Bar Glass

browser.omnibar.glassTint.description: The color over the glass, from the terminal theme. Accent is the theme's own accent color, or gray when the theme has none.
browser.omnibar.glassTint.title: Glass Tint

browser.omnibar.inlineAutocomplete.description: Completes a site you typed before or visit often.
browser.omnibar.inlineAutocomplete.title: Complete Addresses Inline

browser.omnibar.remoteSuggestions.description: Sends what you type to the search engine for suggestions. Never addresses, files or local hosts.
browser.omnibar.remoteSuggestions.title: Search Suggestions

browser.omnibar.shadow.description: A soft shadow under the glass address bar.
browser.omnibar.shadow.title: Address Bar Shadow

browser.omnibar.showFullURLs.description: Shows the whole address, with https:// and www., when you are not editing it.
browser.omnibar.showFullURLs.title: Always Show Full URLs

browser.openLinksInCmuxBrowser.description: When off, links you click in terminals, agent chats, Home and cmux pages open in your default browser. Shift-Command-click opens a link in the other browser.
browser.openLinksInCmuxBrowser.title: Open Links in cmux Browser

browser.openTerminalLinksInCmuxBrowser.description: When off, links clicked in terminal output open in your default browser.
browser.openTerminalLinksInCmuxBrowser.title: Open Terminal Links in cmux Browser

browser.passwords.allowExport.description: Lets the Passwords page write every saved password to a plain-text CSV file, after you confirm with Touch ID or your password.
browser.passwords.allowExport.title: Allow Password Export

browser.passwords.generate.description: Offers a generated password when a site asks for a new one, and saves it.
browser.passwords.generate.title: Suggest Strong Passwords

browser.passwords.offerToSave.description: A browser tab asks to save a sign-in you submit. Tabs an agent drives never ask.
browser.passwords.offerToSave.title: Offer to Save Passwords

browser.remoteLocalhost.title: Open localhost on the Workspace's Machine

browser.searchEngine.description: The address bar searches here and asks it for suggestions.
browser.searchEngine.title: Search Engine

browser.showAgentCursor.description: When an agent drives a browser tab, show its cursor, clicks and typed keys on the page. Password fields show dots.
browser.showAgentCursor.title: Show Agent Cursor

browser.showBookmarksBar.description: A row of bookmarks under each browser toolbar.
browser.showBookmarksBar.title: Show Bookmarks Bar

browser.siteEngines.description: Sites that always open in one engine: a site, such as spotify.com, and chromium or webkit. Spotify, Netflix and other protected media sites open in WebKit, because their media does not play in Chromium.
browser.siteEngines.title: Site Engines

browser.toolbarButtons.description: Buttons shown next to the address bar. The rest are in the More menu, where Show in Toolbar pins them back.
browser.toolbarButtons.title: Toolbar Buttons

browser.toolbarPosition.description: Where the address bar row of browser and Markdown panes sits. At the bottom, its suggestions and menus open upward.
browser.toolbarPosition.title: Browser Toolbar Position

browser.urlsToAlwaysOpenExternally.description: Links that match open in your default browser. Text matches anywhere in the URL, * and ? are wildcards, and re: starts a regular expression.
browser.urlsToAlwaysOpenExternally.title: URLs to Always Open Externally

browser.verificationAutofill.enabled.description: When a site emails you a code or link, its tab offers it. Only on the sender's own site, never filled without your click, and never stored.
browser.verificationAutofill.enabled.title: Fill Codes from Verification Emails

chief.reactionClassifier.harness.description: The agent harness the reaction classifier runs on, for example claude or codex. Empty uses the Chief's Claude route.
chief.reactionClassifier.harness.title: Reaction Classifier Harness

chief.reactionClassifier.model.description: The model that decides whether a reaction starts a turn. Claude Haiku by default: it is fast and cheap.
chief.reactionClassifier.model.title: Reaction Classifier Model

chief.reactionClassifier.prompt.description: What the classifier is told when it decides. Empty uses the built-in instructions.
chief.reactionClassifier.prompt.title: Reaction Classifier Instructions

chief.reactionsCanWake.description: A reaction you put on a Chief message can start a turn when it asks for one, such as a question mark on a question or a thumbs down on a plan. A cheap model decides first, so a reaction that needs no answer never shows the typing dots. Off, reactions are only noted.
chief.reactionsCanWake.title: Reactions Can Wake the Chief

computerUse.driver.description: Legacy runs the current cmux Computer Use helper. Upstream runs the new helper built on the upstream Cua Driver; macOS asks for its permissions separately.
computerUse.driver.title: Computer Use Driver

computerUse.enabled.description: Lets agents see and use your apps through the signed cmux Computer Use helper. macOS asks for Accessibility and Screen Recording when you first allow them.
computerUse.enabled.title: Computer Use

deviceHub.url.description: Overrides the device hub this build signs its devices in to, for Mac Screen sharing between your devices. Leave it empty to use the built-in hub.
deviceHub.url.title: Device Hub Address

diagnostics.hangReports.description: Nightly builds send a daily report of hangs and slow frames: call stacks of cmux and macOS code, timings, your app and macOS versions, your Mac's chip and memory size, and rounded counts of open windows and tabs. It never includes file names, web addresses, terminal text, names or anything you type. View Hang Report shows exactly what is sent.
diagnostics.hangReports.title: Send Hang Reports

diff.showBulkActions.title: Stage All and Revert All Bar

DisableAutoUpdate.description: Turn off automatic updates (also honored in the legacy com.cmuxterm.app domain).
DisableAutoUpdate.title: DisableAutoUpdate

DisabledFeatures.description: Features to turn off: their UI, actions and host operations are removed.
DisabledFeatures.title: DisabledFeatures

DisableTelemetry.description: Turn off anonymous telemetry, crash reports included, whatever the user chose (also honored in the legacy com.cmuxterm.app domain).
DisableTelemetry.title: DisableTelemetry

editor.detectIndentation.description: Tab size and spaces follow the file's own indentation.
editor.detectIndentation.title: Detect Indentation

editor.emptySelectionClipboard.title: Copy the Line When Nothing Is Selected

editor.fontSize.description: Empty uses the terminal font size. Cmd-= and Cmd-- change it in one editor.
editor.fontSize.title: Font Size

editor.formatOnSave.description: Runs the language's formatter when one is installed.
editor.formatOnSave.title: Format on Save

editor.importFrom.description: cmux reads that editor's settings and keybindings files and never changes them. A setting you make here wins.
editor.importFrom.title: Take Defaults From

editor.insertFinalNewline.title: End Files with a Newline on Save

editor.insertSpaces.description: Tab inserts spaces. Off inserts a tab character.
editor.insertSpaces.title: Insert Spaces

editor.lineHeight.description: 0 computes it from the font size. A value under 8 multiplies the font size.
editor.lineHeight.title: Line Height

editor.mouseWheelZoom.title: Zoom with Command and the Scroll Wheel

editor.multiCursorModifier.description: The key you hold while you click to add a cursor.
editor.multiCursorModifier.title: Add a Cursor With

editor.rulers.description: Columns where a vertical line shows.
editor.rulers.title: Rulers

editor.stickyScroll.enabled.description: The lines that open the scopes around the top line stay at the top while you scroll.
editor.stickyScroll.enabled.title: Sticky Scroll

editor.wordWrap.description: Opt-Z turns it on and off.
editor.wordWrap.title: Word Wrap

EnrollmentToken.description: Team enrollment token from the cmux dashboard. Signed-in users in a verified domain of the team join it; the token alone never grants membership.
EnrollmentToken.title: EnrollmentToken

feed.agentPermissionPrompts.description: Each request's tool and command summary goes to your own cmux feed, so your iPhone can answer it.
feed.agentPermissionPrompts.title: Send Agent Permission Requests to the Feed

feed.github.enabled.description: Uses your gh login to read notifications and review requests on this Mac. Sign in with gh auth login first.
feed.github.enabled.title: Connect GitHub

feed.github.pollIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds between GitHub refreshes. Refresh in the Inbox runs immediately.
feed.github.pollIntervalSeconds.title: Refresh Interval

feed.mirrorNotifications.agents.description: Notifications from agents and cmux notify go to your cmux account's feed and can reach your iPhone.
feed.mirrorNotifications.agents.title: Copy Agent Notifications to the Feed

feed.mirrorNotifications.terminal.description: Notifications that programs send through the terminal can contain secrets. Off sends nothing to your cmux account.
feed.mirrorNotifications.terminal.title: Copy Terminal Notifications to the Feed

files.textEditor.description: The app Open in Text Editor uses for a path: an app name, a bundle ID or the path of an app. Empty uses the app that opens source code.
files.textEditor.title: Text Editor

focus.inactiveTabStyle.description: How the other panes' tabs draw subtler when Focused Pane marks tabs: Fade dims them, Tonal steps their text down, Quiet keeps only a faint selected pill.
focus.inactiveTabStyle.title: Unfocused Pane Tabs

freeModel.enabled.description: Lets agents use the free cmux AI model while you are signed out. The first time an agent uses it, cmux proves to the Cloud service that this is a real Mac. Sign in for more models and higher limits.
freeModel.enabled.title: Free AI Model Without Sign-In

history.closed.maxAgeDays.description: Each machine deletes closed items that are older. 0 keeps them however old they are.
history.closed.maxAgeDays.title: Keep Recently Closed Items For

history.closed.maxGroups.description: Each machine deletes its oldest closed tabs, screens, workspaces and windows past this many. 0 keeps them all.
history.closed.maxGroups.title: Recently Closed Items to Keep

history.commandRetentionDays.description: Each machine deletes recorded commands that are older.
history.commandRetentionDays.title: Keep Terminal Commands For

history.terminalCommands.description: Lists finished shell commands in History. Command lines can contain secrets.
history.terminalCommands.title: Record Terminal Commands

home.attachments.keepLocation.description: When off, location data is removed from photos and videos before they are attached.
home.attachments.keepLocation.title: Keep Location in Photos and Videos

home.channelsEnabled.description: Show Channels below Home in the sidebar. You can also turn it on or off from the command palette.
home.channelsEnabled.title: Channels

home.chiefBubbleStyle.description: iMessage shows your messages in blue and the Chief's in gray. Theme uses your theme's accent and surface colors.
home.chiefBubbleStyle.title: Bubble Style

home.chiefEngine.description: Which Chief Home opens. Auto uses this Mac's Chief while it runs here, else the Hosted Chief in the cloud.
home.chiefEngine.title: Engine

home.chiefPetEnabled.description: A small Chief floats over every app and shows agent events above it. Drag it anywhere; click it to message the Chief or reply to a session. While it shows, ⌃⌥⌘C opens its reply box from any app.
home.chiefPetEnabled.title: Show Chief Pet

home.server.description: Direct messages and group chats use cmux Cloud by default. A self-hosted server is reached over Tailscale by its MagicDNS name, for example http://mini.tail1234.ts.net:7320. No password is sent: the server knows you by your Tailscale login. Also accepts a dictionary {"selfHosted": "http(s)://host[:port]"} in a raw profile.
home.server.title: Server

labs.classicHome.description: Show Home as a full page instead of a workspace with the Chief docked on the left. Takes effect after cmux restarts.
labs.classicHome.title: Classic Home

labs.previewFeatures.description: Unfinished surfaces, such as the agent session's coverage label and Pull requests view.
labs.previewFeatures.title: Show Preview Features

layout.closeFocus.description: Which pane gets focus when the focused pane closes.
layout.closeFocus.title: Focus After Closing a Pane

layout.defaultColumnWidth.description: A share of the window width, for Fixed Width new columns.
layout.defaultColumnWidth.title: Fixed Column Width

layout.focusFollowsMouse.description: Moving the pointer onto a pane or scrolling over it focuses that pane. Off keeps focus where you type until you click. Momentum and the first second after typing never move focus.
layout.focusFollowsMouse.title: Focus Follows Mouse

layout.linkPlacement.description: Where a link or file you open from a terminal, an agent chat, Home or a page appears. Split Right uses the pane on the right, or makes one.
layout.linkPlacement.title: Open Links and Files

layout.mainPane.description: Agent Chats keeps an agent chat as the main pane: links, files, subagents and side chats it opens appear as tabs in a column on its right, and closing that column gives the chat its full width back.
layout.mainPane.title: Main Pane

layout.newPanePlacement.description: Open a Tab adds a tab to the focused pane. Split Automatically splits the largest pane, like New Pane (Auto Layout).
layout.newPanePlacement.title: New Terminals and Browsers

layout.paneSeparation.description: How panes are told apart. None draws no border or divider at all; dragging between panes still resizes them. Default: dividers inside the curved main pane, borders otherwise.
layout.paneSeparation.title: Separation

layout.rows.description: Off hides New Row and fits a column's existing rows into it without scrolling.
layout.rows.title: Rows

layout.scrollAreas.description: Side-by-side panes that do not fit scroll sideways instead of shrinking, also in docked columns.
layout.scrollAreas.title: Scroll Areas

layout.scrollModifier.description: Command + Scroll moves columns and rows from anywhere, and a plain scroll always scrolls the pane under the pointer. Without a modifier, a sideways scroll moves columns unless the pane scrolls sideways itself, and rows scroll only over the gaps between them.
layout.scrollModifier.title: Scroll Columns and Rows With

layout.splitSizing.description: Even gives every pane in the column the same size after a split.
layout.splitSizing.title: Split Sizing

layout.stripScrollbar.description: A thin bar under the columns that shows and moves the visible range.
layout.stripScrollbar.title: Column Scroll Bar

layout.tileBrowsers.description: With Split Automatically, new browsers also get their own pane instead of a tab.
layout.tileBrowsers.title: Split for Browsers Too

macScreen.debug.relayOnly.description: Mac Screen tabs connect through the TURN relay only, never directly, to check the relay path. Tabs that are connected reconnect.
macScreen.debug.relayOnly.title: Relay Only

macScreen.systemShortcuts.description: While a Mac Screen tab has the keyboard, shortcuts like ⌘Tab, ⌘Space, Mission Control and ⌘Q go to the other Mac. Needs Accessibility.
macScreen.systemShortcuts.title: Send System Shortcuts to the Remote Mac

ManagedTeam.description: Team id (team_...) that manages this device.
ManagedTeam.title: ManagedTeam

markdown.code.family.description: The font of code blocks and inline code. Empty uses the terminal font. The agent chat uses it too unless it has its own.
markdown.code.family.title: Code Font

markdown.code.scale.description: Code as a share of the text size. A monospaced font looks bigger than the text font at the same size, so code is a little smaller by default.
markdown.code.scale.title: Code Font Size

markdown.font.size.description: The text size every markdown viewer opens at. Cmd-= and Cmd-- change it in one viewer; Cmd-0 goes back to this size.
markdown.font.size.title: Default Font Size

markdown.layout.fullWidth.description: Text fills the whole pane instead of the text width.
markdown.layout.fullWidth.title: Full Width

markdown.layout.width.description: The widest a line of text gets, in characters (30 to 1000). On a wider window the text stays centered with margins. Wide tables and code scroll sideways in their own box.
markdown.layout.width.title: Text Width

markdown.remoteImages.description: Web image sites can see your address and when you open a document. When off, each document asks before loading its web images.
markdown.remoteImages.title: Load Web Images Automatically

markdown.spacing.paragraph.description: The gap after each paragraph, as a share of the text size.
markdown.spacing.paragraph.title: Paragraph Spacing

media.pictureInPicture.enabled.description: Offer Picture in Picture for a web page's video in menus, the command palette and the media controls. A site's own video controls are not affected.
media.pictureInPicture.enabled.title: Picture in Picture

MinimumVersion.description: Oldest cmux version allowed to sign in, for example 1.2.0.
MinimumVersion.title: MinimumVersion

mobile.allowIPhoneConnections.description: Lets the cmux app on your iPhone open this Mac's workspaces, terminals and agent chats while you are signed in with the same account.
mobile.allowIPhoneConnections.title: Allow iPhone Connections

mobile.terminalSizing.description: Decides the size of a terminal while this Mac and a phone show it at once. A device that gets a larger terminal than it fits scrolls sideways or shows empty space; text never wraps wrong. Set the priority order in the cmux app on your iPhone.
mobile.terminalSizing.title: Terminal Size When Shared

mobile.terminalSizingOrder.description: The devices whose size a shared terminal takes first, highest first, when Terminal Size When Shared is Priority Order.
mobile.terminalSizingOrder.title: Terminal Size Priority

navigation.history.scope.description: Workspaces: Go Back and Go Forward move between workspaces and top pages, and return to the tab each one last had focused. Everything: they also step through tabs and panes inside a workspace.
navigation.history.scope.title: Back and Forward Steps

navigation.historyScope.description: What Go Back and Go Forward walk: places in this workspace, in this window, or the focused page's own history.
navigation.historyScope.title: Back and Forward

newTerminal.opensWorkspace.description: Create a new workspace in the current space instead of a tab. Hold Option to reverse this for one click.
newTerminal.opensWorkspace.title: New Terminal Opens a Workspace

notifications.attention.agentChats.description: Ring an agent chat's pane when its turn ends, until you click or type in it.
notifications.attention.agentChats.title: Ring Agent Chat Panes

notifications.attention.flash.description: Clicking an unread pane, typing in it or jumping to it flashes its ring as it goes.
notifications.attention.flash.title: Flash the Pane When Read

notifications.attention.moveToTop.description: A notification moves its workspace to the top of the unpinned rows, unless you are looking at its pane.
notifications.attention.moveToTop.title: Move the Workspace to the Top

notifications.dockBounce.description: When a notification alerts while cmux isn't the active app.
notifications.dockBounce.title: Bounce Dock Icon

notifications.mutedWorkspaces.description: Workspace ids whose notifications are silent. Mute a workspace from its sidebar row menu.
notifications.mutedWorkspaces.title: Muted Workspaces

notifications.quietHours.description: No banners or sounds between these times.
notifications.quietHours.title: Quiet Hours

notifications.showPreviews.description: Whether a banner shows what the agent said, or only where and what state.
notifications.showPreviews.title: Show Message in Banners

notifications.sounds.agents.description: Sounds per agent kind, such as claude or codex.
notifications.sounds.agents.title: Agent Sounds

notifications.sounds.cooldownSeconds.description: Many notifications at once sound once. An agent asking for input still sounds. 0 turns it off.
notifications.sounds.cooldownSeconds.title: Burst Cooldown

notifications.sounds.groups.description: Sounds per group id or name. Set one from the group's sidebar menu.
notifications.sounds.groups.title: Group Sounds

notifications.sounds.volume.description: Sounds cmux plays itself. A banner's default sound follows the system alert volume.
notifications.sounds.volume.title: Volume

notifications.sounds.workspaces.description: Sounds per workspace id. Set one from the workspace's sidebar menu.
notifications.sounds.workspaces.title: Workspace Sounds

notifications.suppressWhileTypingSeconds.description: A pane typed into this recently is marked read at once. 0 turns it off.
notifications.suppressWhileTypingSeconds.title: Quiet After Typing

notifications.timeoutSeconds.description: Used when a source clears after a timeout.
notifications.timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout

palette.aliases.description: A word that names a command by its action id ("vs": "splitRight"). Typing the whole word in the command palette puts that command first.
palette.aliases.title: Command Aliases

palette.pins.description: Commands shown first when the command palette opens, in this order, by action id.
palette.pins.title: Pinned Commands

palette.scopes.commands.prefix.description: Typed into an empty query, this character enters the scope. A prefix you assign moves from any other scope.
palette.scopes.commands.prefix.title: Commands Prefix

palette.scopes.scopes.prefix.description: Typed into an empty query, this character enters the scope. A prefix you assign moves from any other scope.
palette.scopes.scopes.prefix.title: Scope List Prefix

palette.scopes.settings.prefix.description: Typed into an empty query, this character enters the scope. A prefix you assign moves from any other scope.
palette.scopes.settings.prefix.title: Settings Prefix

palette.scopes.tabs.prefix.description: Typed into an empty query, this character enters the scope. A prefix you assign moves from any other scope.
palette.scopes.tabs.prefix.title: Tabs Prefix

palette.scopes.workspaces.prefix.description: Typed into an empty query, this character enters the scope. A prefix you assign moves from any other scope.
palette.scopes.workspaces.prefix.title: Workspaces Prefix

phone.allowConnections.description: So your phone can find this Mac, cmux registers with its servers this Mac's name, device ID and platform, the app's bundle ID, version and build channel, the Mac's relay address and connection key, and your account and team IDs. Workspace names, folders, full paths and terminal output go only over the encrypted link to your phone. None of that, and no branch name or repo URL, is sent to cmux servers. Exception: while “Show This Mac's Workspaces on Your Phone While It's Off” is on, cmux servers store each workspace's ID, resource ID, short ID, name, name revision, group, color, icon, pinned state, unread mark, unread count and whether it is active.
phone.allowConnections.title: Let Your Phone Use This Mac

phone.cloudReplica.description: cmux stores this Mac's workspace names, colors and unread counts so your phone can show them while the Mac is off. A workspace name can be a folder's name. No paths, tab titles or terminal output. Turning this off deletes the copy.
phone.cloudReplica.title: Show This Mac's Workspaces on Your Phone While It's Off

phone.keepAwake.description: A sleeping Mac can't be reached from your phone until it wakes. Closing the lid still puts the Mac to sleep.
phone.keepAwake.title: Keep Mac Awake for Your Phone

phone.startSessions.description: Off, your phone can still follow, type into and answer what's already running.
phone.startSessions.title: Let Your Phone Start New Workspaces

picker.pinned.description: The picker lists these folders under Locations, after Home and Downloads. Use full paths or ~/ paths.
picker.pinned.title: Pinned Folders

RestrictToManagedTeam.description: Refuse sign-in to any team other than ManagedTeam on this device.
RestrictToManagedTeam.title: RestrictToManagedTeam

screenshots.findTools.description: The Screenshots pane also shows the folders of screenshot apps it finds, such as CleanShot X, Shottr and Kap.
screenshots.findTools.title: Find Screenshot Apps

screenshots.folders.description: The Screenshots pane also shows the pictures and videos in these folders. Use full paths or ~/ paths.
screenshots.folders.title: More Screenshot Folders

sessions.allowFullAccess.description: Off, cmux won't switch an agent into a mode that skips approvals.
sessions.allowFullAccess.title: Allow Full-Access Modes

sessions.keepAwake.description: Stops idle sleep while an agent on this Mac is working. Your display can still turn off, and closing the lid still puts the Mac to sleep.
sessions.keepAwake.title: Keep Mac Awake While Agents Work

sessions.promptSuggestions.description: Agents can suggest next tasks, which you start as child chats beside the current one. Agents started after the change get it.
sessions.promptSuggestions.title: Suggest Follow-Up Tasks

sessions.resumeAgents.description: Terminal agents reopen their session after a crash or restart.
sessions.resumeAgents.title: Resume Agents After Restart

shortcuts.showModifierHoldHints.description: Hold Command or Control for 0.30 seconds to show shortcut hints.
shortcuts.showModifierHoldHints.title: Show Shortcuts When Holding a Modifier

sidebar.border.description: A line on the sidebar's edge. Off, the edge shows a line only while you hover or drag it.
sidebar.border.title: Border

sidebar.bottomBandMaxShare.description: The share of the sidebar the bottom sections fill before they scroll.
sidebar.bottomBandMaxShare.title: Bottom Sections Height

sidebar.cards.tips.description: A "Did you know" card above the account button shows one cmux feature a day that you have not used yet. Each tip shows only once.
sidebar.cards.tips.title: Show Tips

sidebar.cmd9.description: Goes to the last item, as in browsers, or to the ninth.
sidebar.cmd9.title: Command-9

sidebar.density.description: Comfortable rows keep one line on taller rows with more space around them. Expanded rows show each workspace's status or folder under its name, how long ago it changed, and its pull request and computer.
sidebar.density.title: Sidebar Density

sidebar.detailedStatusIcons.description: Workspace rows show a separate icon for working, waiting for input, error and done. Off, a row shows a spinner while it works and a blue dot when it is ready for you.
sidebar.detailedStatusIcons.title: Detailed Status Icons

sidebar.groupByComputer.description: Off: one list of workspaces, and a workspace on another computer names it under its title. On: a section per computer.
sidebar.groupByComputer.title: Group Workspaces by Computer

sidebar.groupHeader.memberCount.description: A collapsed group shows how many workspaces it holds after its name. Off, it shows only its loading spinner.
sidebar.groupHeader.memberCount.title: Show Group Member Count

sidebar.groupHeader.unreadCount.description: A collapsed group shows how many unread notifications its workspaces have. Off, it shows only its loading spinner.
sidebar.groupHeader.unreadCount.title: Show Group Unread Count

sidebar.hoverCards.delay.description: How long the pointer rests on a workspace or a tab before its card opens. While a card shows, the next one opens at once.
sidebar.hoverCards.delay.title: Hover Card Delay

sidebar.hoverCards.enabled.description: A card with details opens when the pointer rests on a workspace or a tab.
sidebar.hoverCards.enabled.title: Show Hover Cards

sidebar.hoverCards.groups.delay.description: How long the pointer rests on a group before its summary card opens.
sidebar.hoverCards.groups.delay.title: Group Card Delay

sidebar.hoverCards.groups.maxMembers.description: The most members a group's card lists by name.
sidebar.hoverCards.groups.maxMembers.title: Group Card Members

sidebar.hoverCards.groups.order.description: Which part of a group's card comes first.
sidebar.hoverCards.groups.order.title: Group Card Leads With

sidebar.hoverCards.groups.sections.activ.description: Show the member that changed last, and when.
sidebar.hoverCards.groups.sections.activ.title: Group Card: Latest Activity

sidebar.hoverCards.groups.sections.membe.description: Show the member count and the members' names.
sidebar.hoverCards.groups.sections.membe.title: Group Card: Members

sidebar.hoverCards.groups.sections.statu.description: Show how many members work, wait, failed or have unread items.
sidebar.hoverCards.groups.sections.statu.title: Group Card: Status

sidebar.hoverCards.groups.tabGroups.description: A summary card opens when the pointer rests on a tab group's chip.
sidebar.hoverCards.groups.tabGroups.title: Cards on Tab Groups

sidebar.hoverCards.groups.workspaceGroup.description: A summary card opens when the pointer rests on a workspace group's header.
sidebar.hoverCards.groups.workspaceGroup.title: Cards on Workspace Groups

sidebar.hoverCards.layout.description: What a workspace's hover card shows: its history of prompts and waits, its details, or both.
sidebar.hoverCards.layout.title: Workspace Card Layout

sidebar.hoverCards.maxRows.description: The most prompts, waits and finished turns a workspace's card lists. The list scrolls.
sidebar.hoverCards.maxRows.title: Workspace Card History Lines

sidebar.hoverCards.sections.git.description: The workspace's branch and pull request.
sidebar.hoverCards.sections.git.title: Show Branch in Workspace Cards

sidebar.hoverCards.sections.ports.description: The ports the workspace listens on.
sidebar.hoverCards.sections.ports.title: Show Ports in Workspace Cards

sidebar.hoverCards.sections.prompts.description: Each prompt you sent and when, in the card's history.
sidebar.hoverCards.sections.prompts.title: Show Prompts in Workspace Cards

sidebar.hoverCards.sections.timings.description: How long the workspace has worked or waited, and how long its command has run.
sidebar.hoverCards.sections.timings.title: Show Running Times in Workspace Cards

sidebar.hoverCards.sections.waiting.description: When an agent waited for your input or finished its turn, in the card's history.
sidebar.hoverCards.sections.waiting.title: Show Waits in Workspace Cards

sidebar.minimal.description: Workspace rows show only their icon, name and unread mark, and section titles become thin lines.
sidebar.minimal.title: Minimal Mode

sidebar.minimalMode.description: Hides the chosen sections until the pointer is over the sidebar.
sidebar.minimalMode.title: Hide Bands Until Hover

sidebar.noFade.description: The sidebar's edges stop fading and the whole list shows. It also hides the bottom profile and search bar. Off, the edges fade and the bar shows.
sidebar.noFade.title: Show Whole Sidebar Without Fade

sidebar.nowPlaying.enabled.description: A player for what is playing, at the bottom of the sidebar.
sidebar.nowPlaying.enabled.title: Show Now Playing

sidebar.nowPlaying.otherApps.description: Also show what plays in other apps, such as Spotify, Music or another browser. Off: only what plays in cmux.
sidebar.nowPlaying.otherApps.title: Include Other Apps in Now Playing

sidebar.numbering.description: Every item: Home is Command-1, the App Store Command-2, the first workspace Command-3. Workspaces only: the first workspace is Command-1.
sidebar.numbering.title: Command-Number Shortcuts

sidebar.pinnedBandsScroll.description: Off: the top and bottom sections never scroll and the workspace list gets smaller.
sidebar.pinnedBandsScroll.title: Scroll Tall Sections

sidebar.priorityView.enabled.description: A bell at the top of the sidebar shows every agent chat on every machine, the ones waiting on you first, then finished, failed, working and idle.
sidebar.priorityView.enabled.title: Priority View

sidebar.priorityView.shown.description: The sidebar bell's state while the Priority view is on. Off, the sidebar is unchanged.
sidebar.priorityView.shown.title: Show Priority View

sidebar.sectionLook.description: How the sections above and below the workspace list draw.
sidebar.sectionLook.title: Section Look

sidebar.sessionTree.description: Lists a workspace that another workspace's agent started under it, and shows each row's pull requests and the first rows' Command-number keys.
sidebar.sessionTree.title: Session Tree

sidebar.showChats.description: On the New Tab page, the Threads and Console styles list every coding agent chat on this computer, newest first. Off, they show the recent chats only.
sidebar.showChats.title: Show All Chats on New Tab

sidebar.showColors.description: Workspaces and groups draw their colors in the sidebar. Off, the sidebar draws no colors and keeps the colors you set.
sidebar.showColors.title: Show Workspace Colors

sidebar.showLocalMachine.description: With workspaces on more than one computer, a workspace on another computer shows that computer's icon in its color. On, this Mac's workspaces show its icon too.
sidebar.showLocalMachine.title: Mark This Mac's Workspaces

sidebar.showSearchButton.description: A magnifying glass after the profile button searches workspaces, tabs, history, agent chats, settings and commands. Off, Search stays in the command palette.
sidebar.showSearchButton.title: Show Search Button

sidebar.showTimestamps.description: Workspace rows show when they last changed: a time today, else an age such as 3d. Off, rows show no times; the hover card still does.
sidebar.showTimestamps.title: Show Timestamps

sidebar.showWorkspaceTabs.description: Lists tabs beneath each workspace in the sidebar.
sidebar.showWorkspaceTabs.title: Show Workspace Tabs

sidebar.side.description: The window edge the sidebar sits on. On the right, the window buttons sit over the tab bar.
sidebar.side.title: Sidebar Side

sidebar.spacesPosition.description: Where the spaces dots sit in the sidebar: under the window buttons or above the Settings row.
sidebar.spacesPosition.title: Spaces Position

sidebar.spacesVisibility.description: On Hover shows the spaces only while the pointer is over the sidebar, like its other buttons.
sidebar.spacesVisibility.title: Show Spaces

sidebar.stepping.description: What Command-Control-] and Command-Control-[ step through.
sidebar.stepping.title: Next and Previous Item

sidebar.steppingWraps.description: Past the last item, the next item is the first again.
sidebar.steppingWraps.title: Wrap Around

sidebar.style.description: Rail shrinks the sidebar to a thin strip with a mark for each workspace. Point at the strip to open the full sidebar over your work.
sidebar.style.title: Sidebar Style

sidebar.topBandMaxShare.description: The share of the sidebar the top sections fill before they scroll.
sidebar.topBandMaxShare.title: Top Sections Height

sidebar.workspaceRow.agentStatus.description: The status agents and hooks report, one line each.
sidebar.workspaceRow.agentStatus.title: Agent Status

sidebar.workspaceRow.icon.description: The icon or emoji you chose for a workspace.
sidebar.workspaceRow.icon.title: Icon

sidebar.workspaceRow.log.description: The newest line agents and scripts log: cmux workspace log append <text>.
sidebar.workspaceRow.log.title: Log

sidebar.workspaceRow.notification.description: The text of the workspace's newest unread notification.
sidebar.workspaceRow.notification.title: Latest Notification

sidebar.workspaceRow.ports.description: Set by a hook: cmux workspace status set ports <text>.
sidebar.workspaceRow.ports.title: Ports

sidebar.workspaceRow.process.description: The terminal's title, which the shell or program sets.
sidebar.workspaceRow.process.title: Running Program

sidebar.workspaceRow.progress.description: A progress bar under the row and the busy mark of running work.
sidebar.workspaceRow.progress.title: Progress

sidebar.workspaceRow.pullRequest.description: Set by a hook: cmux workspace status set pr <text>.
sidebar.workspaceRow.pullRequest.title: Pull Request

sidebar.workspaceRow.secondLineOrder.description: The order of the shown items under the workspace name.
sidebar.workspaceRow.secondLineOrder.title: Second Line Order

sidebar.workspaceRow.working.description: A mark while an agent works in the workspace.
sidebar.workspaceRow.working.title: Agent Working

ssh.linkAllowedHosts.description: An ssh:// link from another app connects to these hosts without asking. Remove a host to be asked again. Saved machines and acpmux peers never ask.
ssh.linkAllowedHosts.title: Always Allowed SSH Link Hosts

status.inferCommandBusy.description: A shell command that runs a while shows as busy.
status.inferCommandBusy.title: Show Running Commands

status.runNotifyMinimumSeconds.description: cmux status run notifies when the command took at least this long.
status.runNotifyMinimumSeconds.title: Notify When a Run Takes

status.runNotifyWhenVisible.title: Notify Even When the Terminal Is Visible

tabs.barOrder.description: In a browser pane with the tab bar and the address bar on the same edge: the tab bar above the address bar, or below it.
tabs.barOrder.title: Tab Bar and Browser Toolbar

tabs.barPosition.description: Where each pane's tab bar sits. Bottom also shows the standard title bar, so the window buttons never cover a pane.
tabs.barPosition.title: Tab Bar Position

tabs.cmdWClosesPinnedTabs.description: When off, Cmd-W on a pinned tab selects the next tab and keeps the pinned tab. Close a pinned tab from its menu.
tabs.cmdWClosesPinnedTabs.title: Cmd-W Closes Pinned Tabs

tabs.commandDigits.description: Workspaces: Command-1 to 9 go to sidebar items and Control-1 to 9 to tabs. Tabs: Command-1 to 9 go to the focused pane's tabs and Control-1 to 9 to workspaces.
tabs.commandDigits.title: Command-1 to 9 Select

tabs.newTabNowPlaying.description: A player for what is playing, on the New Tab page.
tabs.newTabNowPlaying.title: Show Now Playing on New Tab

tabs.newTabPosition.description: Where Cmd-T and the + button put the new tab. New Tab to the Right in a tab's menu always puts it after that tab.
tabs.newTabPosition.title: New Tab Position

tabs.newTabTemplate.description: The layout of the New Tab page. Terminal skips the page and opens a terminal. The dots at the bottom of the page also change it.
tabs.newTabTemplate.title: New Tab Template

tabs.newTabWidgets.actions.description: Chats that need you, and New Terminal, New Browser Tab and New Chat.
tabs.newTabWidgets.actions.title: Show Quick Actions on New Tab

tabs.newTabWidgets.chats.description: Your recent chats under the composer. The palette finds any chat.
tabs.newTabWidgets.chats.title: Show Recent Chats on New Tab

tabs.newTabWidgets.clock.description: A quiet local time display beside the composer.
tabs.newTabWidgets.clock.title: Show Clock on New Tab

tabs.newTabWidgets.greeting.description: A headline over the composer that asks what to work on, with the project as a picker.
tabs.newTabWidgets.greeting.title: Ask What to Work On on New Tab

tabs.newTabWidgets.machines.description: Your machines and whether each is online.
tabs.newTabWidgets.machines.title: Show Machines on New Tab

tabs.newTabWidgets.order.description: The order of the widgets on New Tab. Right-click New Tab and choose Edit New Tab to drag them.
tabs.newTabWidgets.order.title: New Tab Widget Order

tabs.newTabWidgets.projects.description: A card of this Mac and its recent projects over the composer.
tabs.newTabWidgets.projects.title: Show Projects on New Tab

tabs.newTabWidgets.quote.description: A bundled public-domain quote, changing daily.
tabs.newTabWidgets.quote.title: Show Quote of the Day on New Tab

tabs.newTabWidgets.styleDots.description: Dots under the page that switch its template.
tabs.newTabWidgets.styleDots.title: Show Template Dots on New Tab

tabs.newTabWidgets.timer.description: A small elapsed-time stopwatch beside the composer.
tabs.newTabWidgets.timer.title: Show Stopwatch on New Tab

tabs.newTabWidgets.warmGreeting.description: A time-of-day greeting such as Good afternoon.
tabs.newTabWidgets.warmGreeting.title: Show Warm Greeting on New Tab

tabs.newTabWidgets.weather.description: The current weather and today's high and low, for the city below or your time zone's city.
tabs.newTabWidgets.weather.title: Show Weather on New Tab

tabs.newTabWidgets.weatherCity.description: A city for the weather widget. Empty uses your time zone's city.
tabs.newTabWidgets.weatherCity.title: Weather City

tabs.overflow.description: Shrink narrows every tab to the minimum width before the strip scrolls. Scroll keeps tabs wide and scrolls sooner.
tabs.overflow.title: Tab Overflow

tabs.plusButton.description: On Hover shows each tab bar's + only while the pointer is over that tab bar.
tabs.plusButton.title: New Tab Button

tabs.swapCmdTAndCmdN.description: When on, Cmd-T opens a workspace in the current group and Cmd-N opens a tab. When off, Cmd-T opens a tab, or a workspace when an agent chat or a pane without tabs is focused.
tabs.swapCmdTAndCmdN.title: Swap Cmd-T and Cmd-N

tabs.terminalFirst.description: New tabs (Cmd-T, the tab bar's +), splits (Cmd-D, Cmd-Shift-D), new workspaces (Cmd-N, the sidebar's +) and new windows open a terminal, as in cmux classic, instead of the New Tab page. To open the New Tab page while this is on, right-click or press and hold the tab bar's +, or run New Tab Page from the command palette (Cmd-Shift-P). Cmd-I still opens an agent chat and Cmd-Shift-L a browser tab.
tabs.terminalFirst.title: cmux Classic Mode

tabs.toolbarButtons.description: Actions shown as buttons next to the tab bar's More button. The rest are in the More menu, where Show in Tab Bar pins them back.
tabs.toolbarButtons.title: Tab Bar Buttons

tasks.layout.description: Inbox lists what needs you first, with the task beside it. Changes apply at once.
tasks.layout.title: Tasks Layout

terminal.fontFamily.description: A monospaced font installed on this Mac.
terminal.fontFamily.title: Font Family

terminal.linkOpener.default.description: Where a URL goes when a program in a terminal opens a browser, such as aws login or gh auth login: cmux, system, chrome, safari, arc, firefox, edge, brave, app:<name>, a profile after @ (chrome@Profile 1), or command:<command> to let your script decide. A BROWSER you set yourself wins.
terminal.linkOpener.default.title: Open Program Links In

terminal.linkOpener.rules.description: Checked in order before the default; the first match wins. Write <match> -> <target>: caller:aws matches the program that opened the URL, and text, * wildcards or re: match the URL. Example: caller:gh github.com -> safari
terminal.linkOpener.rules.title: Program Link Rules

ui.animations.bounce.description: None stops tabs, rows and panes exactly at their place. Subtle lets them settle with a small bounce.
ui.animations.bounce.title: Animation Bounce

ui.animations.cursor.description: The agent cursor glides between points and shows click ripples. Off: it jumps and shows no ripple.
ui.animations.cursor.title: Animate the Agent Cursor

ui.animations.enabled.description: Off turns every animation in cmux off: rows, tabs, panes, menus, cards, the agent cursor, spinners and cmux web pages change at once. On, the switches below choose area by area.
ui.animations.enabled.title: Play Animations

ui.animations.feedback.description: Hover and press highlights, focus fades and theme color changes ease in. Off: they change at once.
ui.animations.feedback.title: Animate Highlights and Colors

ui.animations.home.description: The Chief chat, its bubbles, the composer and the Home list move and fade. Off: they change at once.
ui.animations.home.title: Animate Home and Chats

ui.animations.hoverCards.description: Hover cards and tooltips fade and slide in. Off: they show and hide at once.
ui.animations.hoverCards.title: Animate Hover Cards

ui.animations.indicators.description: Spinners turn, status dots pulse and attention flashes blink. Off: they show a still glyph.
ui.animations.indicators.title: Animate Spinners and Progress

ui.animations.newTab.description: A new tab grows into its place in the tab bar. Off shows it there at once.
ui.animations.newTab.title: Animate New Tabs

ui.animations.newWorkspace.description: A new workspace row opens in the sidebar. Off shows it there at once.
ui.animations.newWorkspace.title: Animate New Workspaces

ui.animations.overlays.description: Menus, popovers, the command palette, sheets, toasts, notices, find bars and cards fade and slide in and out. Off: they show and hide at once.
ui.animations.overlays.title: Animate Menus and Cards

ui.animations.panes.description: Splits, closes, zooms, dividers, focus rings, drop zones and windows open, close and move with motion. Off: they change at once.
ui.animations.panes.title: Animate Panes and Windows

ui.animations.sidebar.description: Rows and groups slide when they reorder, open, close, pin or move to the top, and the sidebar slides when it shows or hides. Off: they change at once.
ui.animations.sidebar.title: Animate the Sidebar

ui.animations.tabs.description: Tabs grow, shrink and slide when they open, close, reorder or collapse into a group. Off: the tab bar changes at once.
ui.animations.tabs.title: Animate Tabs

ui.animations.web.description: Transitions and animations in cmux's own pages, such as agent chats, New Tab and Markdown. Off: they end at once. Websites are not changed.
ui.animations.web.title: Animate cmux Web Pages

ui.calm.description: Calm: nothing slides, springs or spins, hover cards stay closed and the pointer leaves no highlight on tabs, rows and buttons. Still: Calm, and every animation is instant. Your other motion and hover card settings come back when it is off.
ui.calm.title: Calm Mode

ui.paneAnimations.description: Splits, closes, moves, zooms, column scrolls and screen switches slide into place. Off: they change at once.
ui.paneAnimations.title: Animate Panes

ui.reducedBackgrounds.description: Draws windows in the plain theme color, without paintings, wallpapers or glass. Your background choices stay as they are and come back when you turn it off.
ui.reducedBackgrounds.title: Plain Backgrounds

updates.channel.description: Canary and Dev get builds before they reach Nightly. Stable gets only builds that have run a week without problems, so switching to it may mean no updates for a while.
updates.channel.title: Update Channel

updates.downloadAutomatically.description: Off: cmux checks for updates and asks before it downloads one. On: updates download by themselves. Either way, cmux asks before it restarts into an update.
updates.downloadAutomatically.title: Download Updates Automatically

updates.idleInstallMaxWaitSeconds.description: A downloaded nightly installs by itself once agents and commands finish and you stop typing, and never waits longer than this. Terminals and agents carry on after the restart.
updates.idleInstallMaxWaitSeconds.title: Install Within

updates.idleInstallQuietSeconds.description: How long the keyboard and mouse must be idle before a downloaded nightly installs by itself.
updates.idleInstallQuietSeconds.title: Quiet Time Before Installing

updates.installOnQuit.description: A downloaded update installs as cmux quits. Terminals keep running.
updates.installOnQuit.title: Install Updates When Quitting

updates.keepPreviousVersions.description: Earlier builds kept so you can roll back. Uses almost no disk until files change.
updates.keepPreviousVersions.title: Keep Previous Versions

updates.meteredNetwork.description: While downloads wait, a found update shows on Settings and one click downloads it.
updates.meteredNetwork.title: On Metered Networks

updates.showWhatsNew.description: After an update, a card at the bottom of the sidebar links to What's New until you open or dismiss it.
updates.showWhatsNew.title: Show What's New After Updates

updates.web.description: Every Merge: changes to the web UI arrive minutes after they land, without waiting for the next app update. Off: the web UI this app shipped with.
updates.web.title: Web UI Updates

window.titlebar.description: Minimal has no titlebar strip; the top row moves the window.
window.titlebar.title: Titlebar

window.titlebarButtons.description: On Hover hides Back and Forward until the pointer is over the top row. The sidebar button always shows.
window.titlebarButtons.title: Titlebar Buttons

workspaceColors.indicatorStyle.description: How a workspace's color shows in the sidebar: a dot before its name, a bar down the row's edge, or the whole row filled with the color.
workspaceColors.indicatorStyle.title: Workspace Color Style

workspaces.autoArchive.idleDays.description: A workspace counts as idle when you have not opened it and nothing in it changed for this many days. Pinned workspaces, running commands and workspaces that need you never archive.
workspaces.autoArchive.idleDays.title: Idle For

workspaces.autoArchive.style.description: What cmux does with workspaces you have not used for a while. Archived workspaces stay in their group, dimmed and last, and come back when you open them.
workspaces.autoArchive.style.title: Idle Workspaces

workspaces.autoName.description: A workspace you have not named shows its front tab's name: a page's title, an agent chat's title, or a terminal's title or folder. Your own name always wins.
workspaces.autoName.title: Name Workspaces from Tabs

workspaces.newPlacement.description: Where Cmd-N, the + button and the CLI put a new workspace in the sidebar. Pinned workspaces stay above it.
workspaces.newPlacement.title: New Workspace Position

title: cmux (com.manaflow.cmux)
